mapper.insert: INSERT INTO javbus_star (id, name, avatar, birthday, age, height, bust, waistline, hipline, birthplace, hobby, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{avatar}, #{birthday}, #{age}, #{height}, #{bust}, #{waistline}, #{hipline}, #{birthplace}, #{hobby}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), avatar = VALUES(avatar), birthday = VALUES(birthday), age = VALUES(age), height = VALUES(height), bust = VALUES(bust), waistline = VALUES(waistline), hipline = VALUES(hipline), birthplace = VALUES(birthplace), hobby = VALUES(hobby), updated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO javbus_star (id, name, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.name}, NOW(), NOW())
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT st.id, st.name, st.avatar, st.birthday, st.age, st.height, st.bust, st.waistline, st.hipline, st.birthplace, st.hobby FROM javbus_movie_star ms JOIN javbus_star st ON st.id = ms.star_id JOIN javbus_movie m ON m.id = ms.movie_id WHERE m.code = #{code} ORDER BY ms.star_id ASC
